title: Keypad treatment on wear (huawei watch 2) is squashed, causing entry errors
body:
The rows of keypad treatment's number entry and action buttons on this watch's small, round face are too squashed together (as if the line height was < 1.0), resulting in entry errors.  For example, trying to select a number on the last row can lead to accidentally approving the entry, or cancelling it.

There's more screen realestate than is being used though; the screen title, "units" could be moved at least a lineheight higher, (since it's a small word, it will fit into the upper area of the screen, even on a round watch face) giving more room for the buttons/rows.
